why: I run growth experiments every quarter and currently ship or kill them on gut feel. I want to size tests, read results and push back on bad calls without waiting for the data team.
success: Size an experiment for a given baseline rate and minimum detectable effect, and defend the sample size in a review
Read a results table and state whether the effect is real, including the interval, in two sentences
Spot peeking, a mismatched sample ratio or a metric swapped after launch in a colleague's write-up
prior_knowledge: Has heard of p-values but cannot define one
